QuestInfo.name: Beginner Warrior's Third Training Session
QuestInfo.0: You're starting to get into this Warrior thing, but you still have a long way to go. #b#p1022000##k wants to help you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1022000# says a Warrior must possess patience and endurance. He wants you to hunt #r20 #o1110101#s#k. 20 #o011110101#s? It's not going to be easy... \n\n#o1110101# #r#a21301##k
QuestInfo.2: You hunted 20 #o1110101#s! Whew, that wasn't easy!

0.0: 어린 전사 형제여. 성장하는 자네의 모습을 보니 진정 기쁘군. 자네의 눈에서 또 한 명의 강력한 전사가 보이고 있네. 하지만... 아직 자네에게는 부족한 것이 있군. 더 큰 성장을 위해 한 번 더 수련을 받아보겠는가?

yes.0: 좋은 결심이네. 이번에 자네가 해야 할 일은 스텀프 80마리를 사냥하는 것이네. 결코 적지 않은 숫자이지. 하지만 전사라면 무릇 끈기와 인내를 가져야 할 것이니. 멈추지 말고 노력하게.

no.0: 스스로의 힘으로 수련할 수 있다면, 더 이상 권하지 않겠네.

0.0: Young Warrior! I'm happy to see you improve. I can see a strong Warrior's gaze in your eyes. Still... You're short of something. Would you like more training?

yes.0: That's a good decision. This time, you must hunt #r20 #o1110101#s#k, which is no small feat. But, a true warrior needs patience and persistence, so do not give up.

no.0: If you can train yourself, I won't ask you.

1.0: You've hunted 20 #o1110101#s. Excellent, you have gone through some difficult training. My respect for you has grown.

yes.0: When I think you need more training, I'll call you. Until we meet again...keep training hard!

mob.0: You haven't hunted #r50 #o1110101#s#k yet. Don't be impatient. If you want to become stronger, you must persist.
